name: IKEA
metaTitle: IKEA: Furniture store in Ybor City
metaDescription: IKEA Tampa at 1103 N 22nd St is open daily 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Click and collect starts at 10:00 AM, and Thanksgiving and Christmas are closed.

publish.hoursNote: Store hours from the IKEA Tampa page. Click and collect is 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM. The Swedish Restaurant closes at 7:00 PM. Småland hours vary. Closed 11/26/2026 and 12/25/2026.

facts: IKEA, furniture store, Ybor City, Tampa. Address IKEA Tampa 1103 N 22nd Street, Tampa, FL 33605. Listing phone (888) 888-4532. Website https://www.ikea.com/us/en/stores/tampa/.

Store hours Monday through Sunday 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Click and collect Monday through Sunday 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Curbside opens 1 hour before the store. Småland hours may vary, see the store. Swedish Restaurant 11:00 AM to 7:00 PM. Swedish Bistro 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM.
Closed 11/26/2026 Thanksgiving and 12/25/2026 Christmas Day. Special store hours 12/24/2026 11:00 AM to 5:00 PM Christmas Eve and 12/31/2026 11:00 AM to 6:00 PM New Year's Eve.

Standard delivery starting at $19 for IKEA Family members. Click and collect is free for IKEA Family members and $2 if you are not a member. The store holds an order for 24 hours. Curbside pickup: enter on Adamo Dr or N 26th St and have the last 4 digits ready.
Our stored database hours only include Wednesday. The store page lists every day.

Nearby from our coordinates: Citgo 0.35 miles at 1901 E Adamo Dr, slug citgo. Casa Santo Stefano 0.42 miles at 1607 N 22nd St, slug casa-santo-stefano. Blind Tiger Coffee Roasters Ybor City Cafe 0.59 miles at 1823 E 7th Ave, slug blind-tiger. Neighborhood page /neighborhoods/ybor-city.

faq.q: What time does IKEA Tampa open?
faq.a: The store page lists 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM every day. Click and collect is listed from 10:00 AM. Call (888) 888-4532 or check the store page before a holiday.

faq.q: Is the IKEA restaurant on the same clock as the store?
faq.a: The Swedish Restaurant is listed until 7:00 PM. The Swedish Bistro is listed until 8:00 PM, the same close as the store. Småland hours may vary.

faq.q: How does click and collect work?
faq.a: The page says click and collect is free for IKEA Family members and $2 otherwise, and that the store holds the order for 24 hours. Curbside entry is from Adamo Drive or N 26th Street.
